title: ZeroHero: Training Small Language Agents from Scratch
abstract: arXiv:2611.34635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large pretrained language models provide capable policies for interactive tasks, but how much model capacity is necessary for a specialized language agent? We introduce ZeroHero, a framework for training small language agents (SLAs) from scratch. In each environment, a large language model acts as the expert, and we collect its successful trajectories. We pretrain each SLA, which has fewer than 50 million parameters, to predict the expert's responses given the interaction history. We then post-train the agent on its own interactions using proximal policy optimization (PPO). During post-training, reasoning alignment supplements environment rewards with expert supervision on the language the agent generates alongside its actions. We evaluate the agents in three multistep environments where acting requires both understanding and generating language. In Crafter, agents interpret textual observations and generate reasoning before acting. In W

translated_title: ZeroHero：从零开始训练小型语言智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34635v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大型预训练语言模型为交互式任务提供了强大的策略，但一个专门化的语言智能体究竟需要多大的模型容量？我们提出了 ZeroHero，一个从零开始训练小型语言智能体（SLA）的框架。在每个环境中，一个大语言模型充当专家，我们收集其成功轨迹。我们预训练每个 SLA（参数量少于5000万），使其在给定交互历史的条件下预测专家的回应。随后，我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）在智能体自身的交互上对其进行后训练。在后训练过程中，推理对齐在环境奖励之外，还利用专家对智能体在执行动作时所生成语言内容的监督。我们在三个需要同时理解并生成语言的多步骤环境中评估这些智能体。在 Crafter 中，智能体解读文本观察并在行动前生成推理。在 W……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ZeroHero框架，以大语言模型为专家收集成功轨迹，从零预训练参数量少于5000万的小型语言智能体，并通过PPO与推理对齐进行后训练，证明专门化的语言智能体无需依赖大型预训练模型即可完成需要理解和生成语言的交互任务。
